title: Vitrified basalt blocks at Kef Kalesi confirmed by Schoch
summary: Matt LaCroix tells of Vitrified basalt blocks at Kef Kalesi confirmed by Schoch, about recent trip; ancient event at Kef Kalesi, near Lake Van, Turkey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kef Kalesi, near Lake Van, Turkey

tellings.quote: melting that has taken place literal melting of the stone and Dr Robert Shaw confirmed confirmed on numerous stones that it is indeed vitrification

plain: Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient sites, told podcast host Jesse Michels that on a recent trip to Kef Kalesi, an old fortress near Lake Van in Turkey, he found basalt stone blocks that seem to have literally melted. He says a geologist, Robert Schoch, confirmed on many of the stones that this is vitrification, meaning the rock was heated until it turned glassy. LaCroix tells it as a sign of some intense ancient event, perhaps one around 12,000 BC.
